rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something applies to all members of a group.

example.english: This is a universal rule that everyone has to follow.
example.traditional: 呢個規矩係所有人都要遵守嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kwai1 geoi2 hai6 so2 jau5 jan4 dou1 jiu3 zeon1 sau2 ge3

rows.note: Use this when you want to focus on each individual member rather than the group collectively.

example.english: The test is universal: every student has to take it.
example.traditional: 每個學生都要參加呢個測驗。
example.jyutping: mui5 go3 hok6 saang1 dou1 jiu3 caam1 gaa1 ne1 go3 cak1 jim6

rows.note: Use this for something extending across the whole world, especially before a noun with 嘅 or in a wider phrase.

example.english: This song has universal appeal around the world.
example.traditional: 呢首歌喺全世界都咁受歡迎，真係好普遍。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 hai2 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 dou1 gam3 sau6 fun1 jing4 zan1 hai6 hou2 pou2 pin3
